title: Items arriving damaged or defective
situation: Customers are receiving broken or damaged items, risking immediate chargebacks and negative reviews if replacements are not dispatched promptly.

params.reply_en: We are sorry your item arrived damaged. We have processed a free replacement for you, which will ship out shortly.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر لك عن وصول المنتج تالفاً. لقد قمنا بتجهيز شحنة بديلة مجانية لك وسيتم إرسالها قريباً.

actions.why: Acknowledge the damage and confirm the replacement shipment.

actions.title: Damaged items on delivery
actions.answer_en: If an item arrives damaged, we immediately send a free replacement shipment.
actions.answer_ar: إذا وصل المنتج تالفاً، نقوم فوراً بإرسال شحنة بديلة مجانية.

reply_en: We are sorry your item arrived damaged. We have processed a free replacement for you, which will ship out shortly.
reply_ar: نعتذر لك عن وصول المنتج تالفاً. لقد قمنا بتجهيز شحنة بديلة مجانية لك وسيتم إرسالها قريباً.

reply_other.it: Ci scusiamo se il tuo articolo è arrivato danneggiato. Abbiamo elaborato una sostituzione gratuita per te.
reply_other.fr: Nous sommes désolés que votre article soit arrivé endommagé. Nous avons préparé un remplacement gratuit pour vous.
reply_other.pt: Lentamente pedimos desculpa pelo item danificado. Processámos uma substituição gratuita para si.

alternatives.why: Some customers might have received incorrect products instead of damaged ones.
Frustration over delivery times can be conflated with item condition complaints.
